objective: Smoke-test the same tiny code review across Grok, Claude Code, Codex and local Qwen
constraints: No tools, file modifications, external communications or paid API fallback.
Use the pinned provider and model for each independent task.

tasks.prompt: Review this JavaScript function against the rule that adulthood starts at age 18, inclusive: function isAdult(age) { return age > 18; }. Return raw JSON with fixedExpression (the corrected comparison using variable age), testInput (the boundary age), testExpected (the expected boolean). No tools or file operations.
